'''Knattik-root''' was a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]. It was used by the [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] for campfires.<ref name="som">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]'' </ref>
